requiredPositiveCases: Admitted source/funding under production roots independently reopened.
Current owner, exact receiver and full causal history.
Issue, complete funding retention, handover, offline receipt, connected claim or qualified redemption, full once-only credit and reconciliation.
Reserve/Settlement/composite exact amounts and components conserved after repricing.
Funded asset supply, exact unit transfer, collateralized offer, partial fill, cancellation and whole-supply redemption.
Lost replies at each irreversible boundary resolve the exact same original.
positiveEvidenceBoundary: Positive financial and hardware evidence needs the actual adapter, admitted originals and independent assessment. Report booleans and matching vector outputs cannot prove those facts. Unsupported positive cases remain MISSING.

adapterInterface.request: Read a local JSON protocol, selected profile/scope, private fixture references and isolated realm. Execute only cases authorized by the operator of that realm.
adapterInterface.response: Produce a local JSON report with implementation identity, exact profile/scope, source name/SHA-256 references and cases binding id, rail, caseDigest, implementationBuildSha256, observed and evidenceSha256. Supply original evidence as separate files.
adapterInterface.transport: Language-neutral local files or stdin/stdout; no Bankeiz account, permission, callback or hosted enrollment required.
adapterInterface.safety: The supplied checker performs read-only verification and isolated SDK reference tests; it does not execute arbitrary adapters, scripts, financial operations or user source code.
